descriptions.zh:
> 为提升用户体验，云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）对性能监控进行了升级，本接口将下线。更多信息，请参见[【通知】云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）DescribeMonitorItems接口下线](~~189893~~)。

调用本接口获取到监控项列表后，您可以调用[DescribeHistoryMonitorValues](~~473827~~)接口查询实例的历史监控信息。
descriptions.en:
>  To improve user experience, Tair has upgraded the monitoring metrics. The DescribeMonitorItems operation is phased out. For more information, see [The DescribeMonitorItems operation of Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) is phased out](~~189893~~).

After you call this operation to retrieve a list of metrics for a specified instance, you can call the [DescribeHistoryMonitorValues](~~473827~~) operation to query the monitoring history of the instance.
